annotations.exact_quote: Thus, this article introduces a novel self-supervised locality preserving low-pass graph convolutional embedding method (L2GCC) for large-scale hyperspectral image clustering.
annotations.reason_zh: 提出图卷积嵌入方法用于高光谱图像聚类，结合可学习嵌入与聚类目标，满足深度聚类任务。

annotations.exact_quote: In addition, locality preserving low-pass graph convolutional embedding autoencoder is proposed, in which the low-pass graph convolution and layerwise graph attention are designed to extract the smoother features and preserve layerwise locality features, respectively.
annotations.reason_zh: 低通图卷积与逐层图注意力用于提取更平滑特征并保持逐层局部性，体现用图邻域结构对嵌入施加几何一致性/平滑约束。

annotations.exact_quote: In addition, locality preserving low-pass graph convolutional embedding autoencoder is proposed, in which the low-pass graph convolution and layerwise graph attention are designed to extract the smoother features and preserve layerwise locality features, respectively.
annotations.reason_zh: 采用低通图卷积和逐层图注意力的图卷积嵌入自编码器，属于图上可学习消息传递的表示学习。
研究对象为大规模高光谱图像，标题明确指向高光谱图像聚类。

annotations.exact_quote: Finally, we develop a self-training strategy, in which a self-training clustering objective employs soft labels to supervise the clustering process and obtain appropriate hidden representations for node clustering.
annotations.reason_zh: 自训练聚类目标用软标签监督聚类并生成隐藏表示，模型预测作为后续训练信号，属伪标签/自训练。
